critical_code_review_comments: Note: .product-detail-page wrapper has bg rgb(242,244,243) (#F2F4F3) — slightly different from required #F5F3EF that body uses. Visually identical off-white but consider unifying to a single token (--bg-off-white) to avoid future drift.

Note: SCROLL-RESTORE test for /menu → /product → back was inconclusive — the menu height at desktop did not allow scrollTo(0,1200) (page already at scrollY=0 after attempt); Comfort Chicken 'See more' is a button (not <a>), so my anchor-based handle didn't pick it. Recommend main agent verify scroll-restore manually with mouse + back-button on a longer mobile viewport.

Minor: data-testid=collection-header-treats was not found in DOM on /menu category=Raw Dog Treats — the visible 'RAW DOG TREATS' h1 is in the page header itself; consider adding the testid to the h1 for easier targeting. Visual requirement (single header) is satisfied.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 validated all UI/UX refinements on /menu (BoxBuilder), /menu/treats (single header), /product/cd-chicken (hero white card with specs accordions under Key Highlights, FAQ in its own white rounded container, small squarish floating CHECKOUT btn with 10px radius and no counter), and /meal-plan (step 1 visible at top of viewport). All visual + behavioural acceptance criteria PASS. Outstanding minor recommendations: add data-testid=collection-header-treats to /menu/treats h1; unify .product-detail-page bg with body bg token; verify scroll-restore on a long mobile viewport with native back navigation.
